build_lstm_model: build an LSTM encoder-decoder model using LSTMModel.build_model with args and task
create_lstm_encoder: create an LSTMEncoder instance with specified embed_dim, hidden_size, and num_layers
create_lstm_decoder: create an LSTMDecoder instance with attention, encoder_output_units, and num_layers
review_attention_layer: review the AttentionLayer class forward method for attention score computation
summarize_lstm_architecture: summarize the base_architecture, lstm_wiseman_iwslt_de_en, or lstm_luong_wmt_en_de preset configs
